author: Bloodoh
body:
EDITED IT. CHANGED ALL THE THINGS OF THE FEEDBACK.


Hey guys, i have made a new map, it consist in a prison theme, its a public map, i hope you guys like.
I started making it in 2015, without WorldEdit, by hand. And now with the World Edit i finished it.
16v16+


Album: http://imgur.com/a/fFc12

Download: Map devs only.

Loadout:
Full leather armor
Iron sword
16 Potatoes
Diamond Ef1, Fort1, Unb1 pickaxe
Bow
32 Arrows
1 Stack of logs
1 Glass Stack
16 Bottles of Experience
3 Golden Apples

Please give me feedback

replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Great Map! 

What this map has on my Map Criteria:
[✓] Detail
[✓] Room for building & Fighting
[✘] Layers & Structures
[✘] XML
[✓] Etiquette Kit
[✓] Accessibility 
[✓] Sufficient Resources
[✓] Lag Free

Tips:

The map itself is amazing and the detail is neat.
However the resources are extremely generous for example although there is a lot of gold there is some gold, iron & diamond. I dislike the idea of having a very unbalanced game and Gold & Iron would fit better to prevent kill farming and unfair matches.
I suggest adding a centre rectangular island with round edges to allow more room for PVP as for there isn't much room other than defending and bow spam, that's why I suggest it so it isn't a heavily focused bow spam map.
Add some vines to some walls to add detail, the moss looks great but if you had vines there it'd blend in better and improve the overall aesthetics the map.

Conclusion:
This map is outstanding and the usage of world edit is hardly noticeable and the detail everywhere is nice, however a few slight additions, in my opinion would help the map out a lot! 

Regards,
Tiger
